scenario: Correcting mistake of saying 'depend to' instead of 'depend on'
grammar: Second Conditional tracking unstated asset reliance variables
highlights: if our business depended on exports
pattern: If + Subject + Past Simple + on, Subject + would + V1
en: If our business depended on exports, we would open an office here.
tr: İşimiz ihracata bağlı olsaydı, burada bir ofis açardık.
ipa: /ɪf ˈaʊə ˈbɪznɪs dɪˈpɛndɪd ɒn ˈɛkspɔːts wiː wʊd ˈəʊpən ən ˈɒfɪs hɪə/
trPron: if avır biznis dipendid on eksports vi vud opın en ofis hiyır
tense: 'Depend' fiili hayali kurguda da olsa daima 'on' edatını yönetir. If cümleciği Past Simple (depended) olarak kurulur.
collocations: shipping ports container arrays logistics docks map
commonMistake: If our business would depend to exports, we... ❌
